tasks.name: Set up project structure
tasks.description: Initialize the project with the required folder structure and dependencies.

tasks.name: Create frontend layout
tasks.description: Design a single-page layout with a text input area and a save button.

tasks.name: Implement text entry functionality
tasks.description: Enable users to type text into the input area.

tasks.name: Set up backend for saving notes
tasks.description: Create an API endpoint to save notes to the database.

tasks.name: Connect frontend to backend
tasks.description: Integrate the save button with the backend API to save notes.

tasks.name: Set up database for notes
tasks.description: Design and configure a database to store user notes.

tasks.name: Integrate database with backend
tasks.description: Connect the backend API to the database for saving and retrieving notes.

tasks.name: Test text entry functionality
tasks.description: Ensure users can type text into the input area without issues.

tasks.name: Test save notes functionality
tasks.description: Verify that notes are saved correctly to the database via the backend.

tasks.name: Deploy application
tasks.description: Deploy the application to a hosting environment for users to access.

T1.implementation_approach: Create a folder structure with separate directories for frontend, backend, and database, and initialize version control.
T1.notes: Ensure the structure supports scalability and modularity.

T2.implementation_approach: Design a basic HTML/CSS layout with placeholders for text entry and buttons.
T2.notes: Focus on a clean and user-friendly interface.

T3.implementation_approach: Add a text input field and implement JavaScript to handle user input.
T3.notes: Ensure input validation is in place.

T4.implementation_approach: Set up a backend server using a framework like Node.js to handle API requests for saving notes.

T5.implementation_approach: Use AJAX or Fetch API to connect the frontend with backend endpoints for saving and retrieving notes.
T5.notes: Handle errors and loading states gracefully.

T6.implementation_approach: Set up a database like MongoDB or MySQL with a table/collection for storing notes.
T6.notes: Define appropriate fields for storing note data.

T7.implementation_approach: Write backend logic to interact with the database for saving and retrieving notes.
T7.notes: Ensure proper error handling and data validation.

T8.implementation_approach: Test the text entry functionality in the frontend to ensure it captures and processes input correctly.
T8.notes: Test across different browsers for compatibility.

T9.implementation_approach: Test the save notes functionality by verifying data is correctly sent to the backend and stored in the database.
T9.notes: Use both manual and automated testing methods.

T10.implementation_approach: Deploy the application using a platform like Heroku, AWS, or Vercel, and configure the environment variables.
T10.notes: Ensure the deployment process includes proper security and scalability considerations.
